# Text criteria match case-insensitive prefixes, never substrings

**Claim.** Matching runs from the start of the field, ignoring case: `wilhel` finds Wilhelmina, `helmina` finds nothing. Hits come back as full person records in the pagination envelope, with collections null unless $expand asks for them.

Applies to: `~1people/get`

## Observed exchange

_One person to search for. The scoped last name keeps other data out of the results._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Wilhelmina",
  "lastName": "Prefixling-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "wilhelmina.prefixling-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_A lowercase prefix of the first name is enough._

```http
GET /people?firstName=wilhel&lastName=Prefixling-{scope}

→ 200
```
